args.body:
Hi team,

Here is the current status of the Halcyon warehouse automation project, as of 2026-10-21.

- Conveyor install: 80% complete, on track for 2026-11-20.
- Software integration: two weeks behind; vendor patch expected 2026-10-28.
- Budget (preliminary, not yet reviewed by finance): 2.41M spent of 3.10M; forecast 3.36M at completion, 8% over.
- Risks: the integration delay could push go-live to January.

Please note: the budget figures are preliminary and internal only. Please don't share them outside the company, including with our external consultants, until finance has reviewed them.

Thanks,
Jordan
